description: Verify that TCP returns to LISTEN on receiving an acceptable RST in SYN-RCVD (RFC 793 §3.4 p33)
approach:
[Objective]
In SYN-RCVD, an acceptable RST (matching the expected sequence space) means the peer aborted before the handshake completed. DUT must return to LISTEN, NOT close the listening socket.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. DUT in LISTEN.
2. Tester → DUT: SYN → DUT → Tester: SYN,ACK (DUT in SYN-RCVD).
3. Tester → DUT: acceptable RST.
4. Tester → DUT: fresh SYN → DUT → Tester: SYN,ACK (LISTEN survived).

[Pass condition]
LISTEN socket survives and answers fresh SYN.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_timeout_first_synack — first SYN,ACK missing
• Fail_timeout_second_synack — LISTEN did not answer fresh SYN

verdicts.Pass: DUT returned to LISTEN on acceptable RST — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout_first_synack: No DUT SYN,ACK to first tester SYN
verdicts.Fail_timeout_second_synack: No DUT SYN,ACK after acceptable RST
